title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 340 South Loudon Avenue in Baltimore, Maryland, as the "United States Representative Elijah E. Cummings Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U. S. Postal Service located at 340 South Loudon Avenue in Baltimore, Maryland, as the United States Representative Elijah E. Cummings Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A bill renaming a Baltimore, Maryland Postal Service facility after former Congressman Elijah E. Cummings.
summary.what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 340 South Loudon Avenue in Baltimore, Maryland, the United States Representative Elijah E. Cummings Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The act was enacted on January 4, 2025.
